message: Hi Alex, it's Marcus at Luna Hair Studio, nice. Can you also build me a mobile app for bookings and run my Facebook ads while you are at it? Same price?
reply: Hey Marcus, thanks for the reply! To clarify, Northlight only fixes websites — no mobile apps or ad management, so those are outside what we do. The $900 fix pack covers your site issues, plus an optional $250/month care plan after. Happy to point you toward app/ad folks if useful, but can't promise their results either way. Want to start with the site audit?
